fields.Name: T327 - Routine Run History View
fields.Description: Exercises the RoutineHistory command-center view (list vs No-Runs-Yet empty-state, run status chips, linked-record buttons) — a bespoke per-routine audit panel, not the generic related-records grid.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Routines app, if at least one routine card is present, click its run-history icon (a timeline icon among the card's action buttons) to open the History view. Wait for it to load (10-30s possible). Success is the History view rendering — a header showing 'History' for that routine and EITHER a list of run rows (each with a status chip and a start time) OR a 'No Runs Yet' empty state explaining the routine has not run yet. If there are no routine cards at all, that is acceptable: report that the list is empty. You do NOT need to open any linked run record.

judgeValidationCriteria: Opening a routine's history shows a History view for that routine (or the routines list is legitimately empty)
The history shows either run rows with status chips and timestamps OR a 'No Runs Yet' empty state (either is a valid pass)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
